title: From hydrological laws to catchment models: A process-based model matches deep-learning accuracy on three continents
abstract: arXiv:2611.06382v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dooge asked whether hydrology has laws at the catchment scale. We ask whether a low-dimensional system built under physical laws can match the accuracy of neural networks that outperform process-based models on the same inputs. Three laws constrain a lumped catchment model. Conservation makes it a flux-connected storage network, dissipation fixes the sign of every flux and aggregation determines how the unresolved composition enters the fluxes, through effective laws over threshold distributions and a memory of the forcing. These laws admit four kinds of refinement. A parsimonious model under them, CaRT (11 parameters per catchment), is refined in a loop assisted by AI agents. Each refinement addresses an observed deficit through a hypothesis from the literature. The result, CaRT+, has fourteen states, 35 parameters per catchment and no daily neural network. translated_title: 从水文定律到流域模型：一个基于过程的模型在三大洲上达到与深度学习相当的精度
translated_abstract: Dooge曾提出水文在流域尺度上是否存在定律的问题。我们则要问：一个在物理定律约束下构建的低维系统，能否达到神经网络在相同输入下超越基于过程的模型的精度。三条定律约束着一个集总式流域模型：守恒定律使其成为一个由通量连接的储量网络；耗散定律确定了每个通量的符号；聚合定律决定了未解析的组成部分如何通过阈值分布上的有效定律和对强迫的记忆进入通量。这些定律允许多种细化方式。在此框架下的一个简约模型CaRT（每个流域11个参数），在AI代理辅助的循环中被逐步细化。每次细化都通过文献中的一个假设来解决观察到的模型缺陷。最终得到的CaRT+模型具有十四个状态变量、每个流域35个参数，且不包含任何日尺度神经网络。大多数细化源于对阈值的聚合或来自新的状态变量。
tldr: 该研究基于守恒、耗散和聚合三条水文定律构建简约流域模型CaRT，并通过AI代理辅助的假设驱动迭代细化得到CaRT+模型，在不使用日尺度神经网络的情况下于三大洲达到与深度学习相当的精度，证明物理定律约束的低维模型可以匹敌神经网络。
en_tdlr: Built from three hydrological laws (conservation, dissipation, and aggregation), the parsimonious CaRT model is iteratively refined through AI-agent-assisted, hypothesis-driven steps into CaRT+, which matches deep-learning accuracy across three continents without any daily neural network, showing that low-dimensional physically constrained models can rival neural networks.
